title: Group Differently and Fact Families: Supplementary Practice
description: Supplementary practice for grouping three addends, comparing totals, completing addition and subtraction fact families, and using addition to solve subtraction facts.
learningFocus: Understand that changing how three addends are grouped does not change the total, and use related addition and subtraction facts to complete fact families within 20.
adultGuidance: Use this supplement after Addition Fact Strategies Within 20, Subtraction Fact Strategies Within 20, and Unknown Numbers & True or False Equations. Ask your child to compare both groupings on Page 1 and explain why the total stays the same; on Page 2, have them say the related addition facts aloud before completing each subtraction fact.
